Exclusive 4×4 vehicle — full day game drive (per vehicle) Ksh 56,000 High Season Ksh 42,000 Mid & Low
Definitions and Terms and Conditions
Eligibility to A valid proof of East Africa residency (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda and Burundi) is
Resident rates required for each guest at the time of booking
Resident travelling with Non Resident Resident travelling with Non Resident on Game Package will automatically be charged the drinks supplement
If Resident & Non Resident share Osim Private House, the Resident or Non Resident rates will apply respectively
Adult rate definition Adult rate applies from 12 years old
Child rate and Adult rate definition Child below 4 yrs : free of charge Child rate applies for children 4 to 11
Special rule if 1 Adult & 1 Child sharing a tent The Adult is charged the per person rate plus the Single sup & the child 50% of the per person rate
Adult & 2 Children sharing a tent Adult is charged charged the per person rate plus the Single sup & each Child is charged 50% of the per person rate
Number of Single tents High Season: Max 2 singles per group Mid
and low: Maximum 3 singles per group
Single rate for Deluxe tent Double deluxe rate will apply
Single rates for Osim Private House non Excl Double Adult rate will apply
3rd Adults sharing a Deluxe Two Adults will be charged the Deluxe tent rate (base 2), the 3rd Adult will be charged the Classic tent per person rate
Resident Park fees A valid Park Fee is required for all game drives, as they take place within the official
(subject to changes) reserve, the Mara Triangle. Park Fees are valid daily from 6:00 pm to 6:00 pm.
Adult Park fee: Ksh 2,500 from Jan to 30th June and Ksh 5,000 from 1st July to 31st Dec
Child aged 9-17 : Ksh 300 from Jan to 30th June and Ksh 500 from 1st July to 31st Dec
Persons under 8 years and below are free
Payment & Payment must be adhered to and must be made in the nominated currency stated on the invoice
cancellation policy Invoices can be paid by wire transfer or cheque. Any payment due for booking within 30 days
must be paid by wire transfer or cash to the bank
For all bank transfers, kindly ensure that no bank charges are deducted from the amount
payable to Escapades Ltd. A copy of the bank/wire transfers should be shared via email
Full refund minus bank charges if cancellation occurs more than 60 days before arrival
30% if cancellation occurs: 59 to 30 days before arrival
100% if cancellation occurs: 29 days before arrival & no show
To secure the booking: 30% deposit of the total amount invoiced
Full amount: 30 days prior to the arrival date
If the full payment is not received 30 days prior, we will release the booking
Cancellation must be made in writing and must be acknowledged in writing in order to be valid
No refunds will be issued for unused services after the check-in date
Any additional arrangements will bepayable directly at the camp
The Management reserves the right to deny services to guests if payment in not made in
accordance with the agreed terms
Booking process Check online our availability
Provisional booking & confirmation by email only at info@kilimacamp.com
Booking will be held for 14 days
